en.headline: Hong Kong actor Simon Lui, known as King of Ghosts, dies at 62
en.dek: Fellow actor Frankie Ng said Lui’s wife confirmed he died of gastric cancer in a Guangzhou hospital on 7 September.
body: Hong Kong actor and filmmaker Simon Lui Yue-yeung, a familiar face in local horror cinema, has died at the age of 62, fellow actor Frankie Ng Chi-hung told reporters on Friday.

Ng said Lui’s wife, television and radio host Ma Li, confirmed that the actor died in a Guangzhou hospital on 7 September after a relapse of gastric cancer. The family had asked for the matter to be handled quietly and there was no public announcement at the time. Reports said a private funeral was arranged for Saturday.

Born in 1964, Lui joined Television Broadcasts Limited’s artiste training course in 1988 and later moved into film. He became closely associated with the long-running Troublesome Night comedy-horror series from the late 1990s and was widely nicknamed the “King of Ghosts” for the volume of supernatural roles he took on.

He also worked as a director, writer and producer on smaller local productions. In recent years he had stepped back from public appearances and was living mainly in Guangzhou. He is survived by his wife and their son.

zh.headline: 「鬼王」雷宇揚胃癌病逝廣州 享年62歲
zh.dek: 演員吳志雄周五轉述，雷宇揚妻子馬莉證實他於9月7日在廣州醫院逝世，家屬希望低調處理。
body: 資深演員及電影人雷宇揚因胃癌去世，享年62歲。同是演員的吳志雄周五向傳媒表示，雷宇揚妻子、主持馬莉已證實消息。
吳志雄指，雷宇揚於9月7日在廣州一間醫院病逝，家人希望保持低調，因此未有即時公開公布。報道指喪禮以私人形式於周六舉行。
雷宇揚生於1964年，1988年入讀無綫電視藝員訓練班，其後轉戰影圈。上世紀九十年代末起參與《陰陽路》系列等靈異喜劇，因大量演出鬼片角色而被稱為「鬼王」。
他亦曾執導、編劇及監製本地製作。近年較少公開露面，主要在廣州生活。他遺下妻子及一子。
